description: Attach pwa-debug to one page over CDP and inject its page-world bridge, so every pwa-debug tool (framework, store, PWA, interaction, evaluate, console/network/error capture, navigation) works on that page exactly as through the extension. Returns a connection id ('cdp:host:port:target') to pass as extension_id to the other tools. Picks the page by target_id, by url_contains, or the single regular page when only one is open. reload:true reloads so the bridge is present before the app starts. Args: { browser_url, target_id?, url_contains?, reload? }. For an Android phone: forward its DevTools socket first with `adb forward tcp:9223 localabstract:chrome_devtools_remote` (run it yourself if you have a shell, otherwise give the user that command), then use browser_url "9223". To load a desktop dev server on the phone, also run `adb reverse tcp:<port> tcp:<port>` so the phone can open http://localhost:<port>.

browser_url.description: Debug endpoint: a port ('9222'), 'host:port', or an http/ws URL.

reload.description: Reload after attaching so the bridge runs before the app code (needed for hooks that must exist at startup).

target_id.description: Page target id (or its prefix) from pdl_cdp_targets.

url_contains.description: Attach to the page whose URL contains this text.

name: pdl_cdp_attach
